events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game for British music. What's your favourite track from this iconic debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, drawing hundreds of thousands to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Imagine being there for 'three days of peace and music'!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The "King of Rock and Roll," Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977, at his Graceland estate in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll lives on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, in Las Vegas, six days after a drive-by shooting.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed in 1996. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar changed everything.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead vocalist and primary songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as the iconic voice of The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single "Imagine" was released in the UK on October 1, 1975, four years after its US album release.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A message that still resonates.

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' back in '62. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Pioneering musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His vision and music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sounds incredible.
